# Morales Padia Law

> Award-winning family law, estate planning, criminal defense, and probate law firm based in San Antonio, Texas. Serving Bexar County and surrounding areas.

## Services
- Family Law: divorce, child custody, child support, visitation, protective orders, modifications
- Criminal Defense: DWI, assault, drug offenses, theft, weapons charges, juvenile defense, expunctions
- Estate Planning: wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance directives
- Probate Law: probate administration, small estate affidavit, affidavit of heirship, probate disputes
- Additional: postnuptial agreements, name changes, record sealing

## About
Morales Padia Law is led by attorney Trisha Morales Padia, an award-winning San Antonio lawyer with extensive experience in family law and estate planning. The firm offers free consultations and serves clients across Bexar County and the greater San Antonio area.
